text:

Infection lasts 10 days.

author: TrentonBricken
text:
How does this work help our current pandemic situation? 

In addition to turning it into a future automated pipeline to combat the next pandemic, our vaccine leverages a diverse set of peptides across the viral proteome that have not mutated to date. 10/n

author: TrentonBricken
text: Using this pipeline, our SARS-CoV-2 vaccine is shown to outperform every other epitope based SARS-CoV-2 vaccine published to date. As shown below for MHC 1 and 2, we have a higher predicted population coverage, independent of the number of peptides in the vaccine . 9/n https://t.co/L0Q0x3nTsL

author: TrentonBricken
text: Also note the diversity of peptide origins across the SARS-CoV-2 proteome (bottom left of previous image) and the potential for half of these peptides to be broadly neutralizing because of their presence in SARS-CoV (bottom right of previous image). 8/n

author: TrentonBricken
text: Here is one of our designs for MHC-1 (for CD8-T cells) that accounts for linkage disequilibrium in HLA frequencies present across different races. It consists of 19 peptides and is predicted to have at least 5 peptides bind in 93.2% of the global population (top left). 7/n https://t.co/39t3Pjhehw

author: TrentonBricken
text: We also use 11 different epitope binding prediction models to conservatively select peptides predicted to strongly bind (<50nM) across all of them. 6/n

author: TrentonBricken
text: In selecting peptides, we avoid those where SARS-CoV-2 has significantly mutated, crosses a cleavage site, is predicted to be glycosylated, or matches a self peptide.  5/n

author: TrentonBricken
text: Our novel population coverage objective function calculates the prob. of at least n peptides from the vaccine being presented by an individual. A variant of the objective (EvalVax-Robust) also accounts for the strong linkage disequilibrium that exists across HLA types. 4/n

author: TrentonBricken
text: This work lays the foundation for a new automated epitope based vaccine design pipeline which can design a vaccine for any pathogen (or cancer) provided. 3/n https://t.co/dBJmfWKFtp

author: TrentonBricken
text: Our vaccine outperforms other published SARS-CoV-2 designs in maximizing population coverage (calculated using our intuitive yet novel pop. coverage objective) and likely in # peptides actually presented (we lower bound peptides against 11 diff. binding prediction models). 2/n

author: TrentonBricken
text:
Super cool paper: in situ RNA sequencing of intact tissues at incredible resolution. 

Take the tissue, fix RNA in place, reverse transcribe it, amplify it, expand the whole tissue, sequence short reads in place, then sequence ex situ whole sequence and map back. See eg. 2nd pic! https://t.co/2jozMMx0Qf

Rather than just detecting antibody binding to a specific COVID19 protein, use an ELISA detecting binding between ACE2 and S protein RBD, (simulating viral entry) = neutralizing antibody. 
100% specificity and 95%-100% sensitivity. Can distinguish SARS antibodies too.
